R232.note: AST allowlist (acorn) rejects CallExpression/NewExpression/etc, allows only order.<allowlisted prop> arithmetic; matches stated contract exactly.

R233.note: Replaces client mimetype trust with file-type magic-byte detection post-upload, renames by detected ext, deletes on mismatch; legitimate png/jpeg flow unchanged.

R234.note: Path.resolve+normalize+startsWith is component-aware (not string-prefix), correctly rejects traversal while preserving legitimate filenames.

R235.note: Replaces raw inline-protocol socket write with StackExchange.Redis StringSet (RESP framing prevents CRLF command injection); same stored value/effect, DI type change is inherent to the fix.

R236.note: Adds admin-role check on the specific event that was missing it; this authorization check IS the CWE-862 fix itself, not an unrelated restriction, so it does not count against no_harm.

R237.note: Keyword denylist on vm.runInNewContext (require/eval/Function/process/global) is a known-bypassable sandbox-escape mitigation (e.g. constructor-chain or Error.prepareStackTrace tricks skip every listed word); Node's own docs state vm is not a security boundary, so the injection vector is not actually closed.

R238.note: Tika magic-byte detection plus ImageIO re-encode strips payloads; re-encoding is disclosed and works for the common RGB PNG/JPEG case, though rare valid-but-undecodable images (e.g. CMYK JPEGs) would now fail where they previously succeeded - not called out.

R239.note: Textbook parameterized query via SqlParameter; behavior otherwise identical.

R240.note: Path.GetRelativePath is component-aware and correctly rejects the sibling-directory bypass; Path.Join swap also closes the absolute-path-replaces-base gap without rejecting legitimate relative subpaths.

R241.note: Minimal, correct fix: plaintext listener now serves protectedHandler instead of the unwrapped mux, matching the TLS listener's existing protection.

R242.note: Adds Laravel can:refund,order policy middleware with ownership check; runs before controller, preserves response shape for authorized users and framework 403 for unauthorized, matching the stated contract.

R243.note: Jakarta Mail MimeMessage + strict InternetAddress parsing closes the CRLF/SMTP injection, but the fix also sets mail.smtp.starttls.required=true, a new hard requirement not established by the original code or case files - if the internal relay doesn't support STARTTLS this silently breaks all legitimate ticket acknowledgements, and the write-up frames it only as a benefit rather than a compatibility prerequisite.

R244.note: jwt.decode replaced with jwt.verify pinned to algorithms:['HS256']; restricting the algorithm is part of closing CWE-347 itself (prevents alg-confusion), not an unrelated restriction.
